description: Jordan has a spare room in the apartment and must decide whether to sublet it to an interested acquaintance, then finalize the rent, deposit, term, household quiet arrangement, and trust checks with the people gathered for the discussion.

shared_context.S1: Jordan has one furnished spare room available in the apartment.
shared_context.S2: The room is available for an informal sublet beginning in August.
shared_context.S3: Jordan makes the final decision about the sublet and its verbal terms.
shared_context.S4: Jordan's normal sublet practice is to ask everyone involved for any relevant proposed terms, household constraints, or references before settling the arrangement.
shared_context.S5: Jordan's usual verbal-sublet checklist records the selected applicant's exact rent, deposit, term, and move-in date, records the exact monthly amount of any external competing room offer separately from an applicant's own proposed rent, and turns each accepted household or conduct requirement into its own explicit commitment before the discussion closes.
shared_context.S6: The apartment's house rules treat quiet hours and smoking restrictions as separate obligations for the people living there, rather than leaving either expectation implied.
shared_context.S7: When comparing rooms, Jordan records an outside room's monthly rent separately from the rent proposed for Jordan's room.
shared_context.S8: Jordan's customary sublet practice is to choose an applicant whose complete proposal is supported by a former-landlord reference over an applicant without such a reference, provided the proposed terms are workable and recorded exactly.

PF1.text: Elena's concrete proposal is $725 per month, a $300 deposit, a six-month term, and move-in on August 1st; she has not yet stated these exact terms to Jordan.

PF2.text: Marcus has another interested-room offer for exactly $760 per month with a four-month term and August 15th move-in; he learned this from the other leaseholder yesterday and has not shared it with the group.

PF3.text: Priya works night shifts on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday and requires quiet in the apartment from 21:00 until 07:00 on those nights.

PF4.text: Sam was Elena's former landlord and confirms that Elena paid on time throughout her prior lease and did not smoke inside; Sam has not previously given Jordan this reference.

decisions.alternative_monthly_rent: integer; must be the exact monthly amount of the external competing room offer, not Marcus's own proposed rent

credited_facts: fact_id; include every revealed private fact used in the settlement

commitments.detail: string; record quiet hours and no-smoking-inside as separate explicit commitments, with the exact days and times in the quiet-hours detail

justification_fact_ids: fact_id; cite each revealed private fact that supports the decision

acceptance_conditions: The room must be sublet to Elena.
The monthly rent must be exactly $725.
The term must be exactly six months beginning August 1st.
The settlement must record Marcus's exactly $760 alternative as the comparison offer.
The quiet arrangement must cover Monday, Wednesday, and Friday nights from 21:00 until 07:00.
A separate explicit commitment must state quiet hours on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday nights from 9 PM to 7 AM.
A reference check for Elena must be completed.
A separate explicit commitment must state that smoking is not allowed inside for Elena.
Jordan must cite Marcus's alternative when justifying the final arrangement.
Every revealed private fact used in the settlement must be listed in credited_facts.

content_checks.C5: decisions['quiet_nights'] == ['Monday', 'Wednesday', 'Friday'] and decisions['quiet_start'] in ['21:00', '9 PM', '9:00 PM'] and decisions['quiet_end'] in ['07:00', '7 AM', '7:00 AM']
content_checks.C6: any('Monday' in c['detail'] and 'Wednesday' in c['detail'] and 'Friday' in c['detail'] and (('9 PM' in c['detail'] or '9:00 PM' in c['detail'] or '21:00' in c['detail']) and ('7 AM' in c['detail'] or '7:00 AM' in c['detail'] or '07:00' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any((c['type'] == 'no_smoking_inside' or c['type'] == 'smoking_restriction') and 'smoking' in c['detail'] and (('inside' in c['detail']) or ('unit' in c['detail']) or ('apartment' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Elena's exact proposal changes the settlement to Elena at $725 with a $300 deposit, a six-month term, and an August 1st move-in instead of unspecified sublet terms.

Marcus's information changes the comparison entry to the exact $760 monthly amount of his external room offer, rather than his own proposed rent, and gives Jordan the specific benchmark to cite and credit.
Priya's work schedule changes the quiet arrangement to Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 21:00 to 07:00 and requires a separate commitment whose detail records those exact nights and times.
Sam's former-landlord confirmation changes the trust step to a completed reference check and supports a separate explicit smoking restriction commitment covering smoking inside the apartment or unit.
